source_text: Si anima peccaverit et mentietur proximo in deposito vel societate, delictum est. Fides inter fratres altare est. Mendacium spoliat communionem.
pass_a_gloss: If soul will-have-sinned and will-lie to-neighbor in deposit or partnership, offense is. Faith among brothers altar is. Lie strips communion.
pass_b_english: If a soul sins and [[lies to a neighbor about a deposit or partnership >> Bible:Leviticus 6:2]], that is guilt. Trust among brothers is an altar. A lie strips communion.
